title: Creating an item must answer 201 with its location
goal: REST clients that follow the standard know an item was created and where to find it.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /todos answers 201 Created (reported: it answers 200) with the new item as the body.
The answer has a Location header with the item's path, for example /todos/3; other answers have no Location header.
The tests check the status exactly, so the bug cannot come back.
